caption.text:
Seorang pria di Banten memergoki seseorang yang diduga hendak membawa sepeda motornya. Alih-alih marah, pemilik motor justru tetap tenang dan bertanya, “Mau dibawa ke mana motornya?”

Orang tersebut kemudian berdalih hanya ingin mengisi bensin. Sikap kalem sang pemilik motor pun mencuri perhatian warganet dan mengundang beragam komentar.

#Okezone  #PencurianMotor
caption.text_translation:
A man in Banten visited a person suspected of being on his motorcycle. Instead of getting angry, the owner of the motorcycle just kept calm and asked, "Where do you want to take the motorcycle? ”

The guy then switched just wanted to fill up gas. The calm attitude of the motorcycle owner also steals the attention of the citizens and invites various comments.

 #Okezone #PencurianMotor
